symbols.symbol: i = (sᵢ, tᵢ, eᵢ, τᵢ, xᵢ, zᵢ)

All displayed intervals are half-open ISO calendar dates. Source fold ends and observed maximum dates are inclusive and are converted by adding one day. A band spans possible dates, not continuous observations.

symbols.definition: Ω is the pinned prepared panel, with quote and settlement strictly before 2024-01-01. S₀ is the ticker list in the pinned recipe. Earlier-side membership always requires settlement strictly before its boundary.

Counts use the fold bands before admission. The configured minimum disjoint-label count is zero. Exact retained memberships are stored in each R-model-f run; the retained lane is the shared MLP component of M51 and selected M53. This is predictive sample admission, not the undecided 2019 MIO gate.

symbols.symbol: c_f = first(last₈₂({t ∈ calendar(Ω|S₀) : a_f ≤ t < b_f}))
symbols.definition: a_f and b_f are the training-window endpoints. c_f is the first of the last 82 distinct observed quote dates in that window, not 82 calendar days. b_f is inclusive train_end + one day.

symbols.symbol: T_f = D([a_f,c_f); S_f) ∩ E(c_f); C_f = D([c_f,b_f); S_f) ∩ E(v_f)

finite means every scalar in the grid vector is a finite real number. R_K is target readiness: it does not require a known outcome or market_eligible=true. The row may receive fitted QA only if its applicable whole-fold M51 or rolling-block M53 QA fit exists and i∈R_K. All these row predicates are over Ω_score, not the complete predictive panel.

QA learning eligibility requires all four component grid CDFs, the eligible flag and a finite outcome. It is stricter than target readiness and differs from the market PIT-map learning set. Its rows retain source fold, band and order.
u_market is the declared market_pit column, not a recomputation from the truncated grid. PIT calibration needs only the source market CDF and PIT, not all four QA components.

Deterministic stride in the input row order, not a random sample or the first L rows. L=∞ gives every row. Scoring bands are ordered by (symbol,quote_date,expiry); QA preserves source-artifact order after its learning filters. Each global/bucket QA fit applies its own stride.

T and V are full predictive populations. T̃ is the scored fit subset, Ṽ is the complete validation band. Source records preserve (fold,band,symbol,quote_date,expiry), so repeated physical observations in different folds remain separate. T_f^src and V_f^src are the scored versions of T̃_f and Ṽ_f. Their exact byte identity is the pinned rows.parquet; full and scored counts are in R-scores.

Common ranked-validation reporting rows for the pinned M51 tables. This mask is distinct from U_PIT, U_QA and target readiness R_K. No fitted=true condition or separate market_eligible condition is imposed by the table constructor. A declared grouping additionally excludes rows lacking any of that grouping's category codes.

M51/M53 grid score: Z={-3,-2.5,…,3}; w=1 at |z|=0.5…2.5 and 0.25 at z=0,±3. Report A0002 primary twCRPS plus full CRPS, strike Brier/reliability and PIT/tail diagnostics under their registered implementations. Grid13 is an approximation, not the full-distribution integral.

Learn on the pinned source artifact's sampled fit rows for fold f. Estimate the empirical PIT CDF at 21 equally spaced knots and interpolate across all source rows of that fold. If A_f^PIT is empty the calibrated component remains missing. Full T_f instead supplies neural/empirical fitting; C_f supplies early stopping.

functions.formula: L_f=(⋃_{g<f}V_g^src)∩E(v_f)∩U_QA; ŵ_f,global=FitQA(S₁₀₀₀₀₀(L_f)); ŵ_f,b=FitQA(S₁₀₀₀₀₀(L_f∩bucket_b)) when |L_f∩bucket_b|≥5000; ŵ_f(r)=ŵ_f,b(r) if fitted, else ŵ_f,global; F̂_f,r^M51=Inverse(Σ_{k∈K}ŵ_f,k(r)Q̂_f,k,r) if a whole-fold fit exists and r∈R_K, else F̂_model,r
functions.meaning: Whole-fold fitting declines when |L_f|<5000, tested before striding. Otherwise fit global QA and each bucket with at least 5000 pre-stride rows. Each applies a separate deterministic stride capped at 100000 and uses 199 quantile levels. A missing/undersized bucket uses global QA and remains fitted=true on ready targets. MLP fallback with fitted=false applies when the whole-fold fit is absent/declined or a target lacks a component. Fold 1 has empty prior-validation evidence. Source-validation learning has strict settlement τ<v_f. No external-component joins, feature-conditioned filters or recency weighting apply to this JSON. QA weights lie on the simplex; the numerical fit is not a global optimum certificate.

study.notes: ADR-0270 strike-screen FIT document for loss L1: a CDFExperiment queue (python -m dskit.pipeline.libs.cdf_experiment DOC --regime pooled), NOT a CDFHyperparameterStudy; the execution-path decision in docs/architecture/decision-log.md moved the fits here (every recipe scored on the whole validation window, resumable cells, per-epoch learning curves). A CDFExperiment document has no top-level notes key (its keys are exactly CDFExperiment.KEYS), so the explanations live in this study block. SHARED with its sibling documents (a test pins it): study, arms, candidates, capacity, training except the losses and the output. panel: the cached frame the panel stage of configs/strike-screen-panel-source.json writes (<its experiment.output>/panel-cache/frame.parquet); panel_sha256 is a 64-zero PLACEHOLDER: the registration step replaces it with that frame's sha256 (record.json frame_sha256) in a resolved copy, never in this file. source_hashes and dependencies are EMPTY placeholders: the registration step resolves them exactly as the R6 prepare did (sha256 of the eight anchors dskit/__init__.py, dskit/pipeline/__init__.py, dskit/pipeline/libs/__init__.py and dskit/pipeline/libs/{cdf_experiment,predictive_cdf,parquet,torch_ts,transformers}.py under the executing checkout, which must include parquet.py and exactly one cdf_experiment.py anchor; and the installed versions of lightgbm, numpy, pandas, pyarrow, scikit-learn, torch and transformers). Empty means unpinned: do not run before they are filled. features = the 279 columns of the panel source in its order: 42 price/calendar (ret_lag_0..21 at positions 6..27), own_iv, 118 chain columns, 118 symbol one-hots. The ARMS read the first 42 (price_only) and the first 161 (price_plus_chain); the experiment queue appends the 118 pooled one-hots itself (head_features), so the arms never list is_<SYM>. observed_columns is empty for both arms: the two arms then admit identical rows and groups, so their differences are the inputs, not the sample (a non-empty list would drop rows lacking every listed column from that arm). Pooled regime only; the queue adds one output head per ticker to the shared encoder trunk (118 heads, about 9.6k parameters; protocol revision 3 states this, and a single shared head is a promotion-rung axis), read from the learning curves. No decision_context and wing_metrics false: the queue trains the contexts as the fixed wings of tail_intervals (thresholds -2.5, -0.5, 0.5, 2.5, equal weights), so L1's tail_crps integrates tail_intervals and L3's decision_brier is the Brier at the wing edges; the strike-level assessment at the row's LISTED strikes is StrikeRegionScores (run-strike-region-scores*.json), not this queue. tail_weight 1.0 is required by the queue's weighted_crps column. horizon_empirical is the paired baseline (the queue overrides horizon_index 0 and reference_index 1 on its own two-column input; the declared indices are those of calendar_dte and reference_scale in features). The queue's capacity: max_parameters = min(100000, 0.25 x fit rows), head width 8 with the head under 4 parameters per fit row of every group; a cell that fits no configuration is a recorded skip, consumed. unpooled capacity is the mixture grid's and is never run. Caps (protocol, enforced by the invocation): 14400 s wall in total, 1e9 output bytes, 8 GiB host RSS increment, 12 GiB VRAM, one GPU process, no retries. Holdout: date_upper_exclusive = end_upper_exclusive = fold_table.holdout_start = 2024-01-01; within the revision-3 runbook, rows at or after 2024-01-01 are never returned, emitted, written or used (protocol windows.holdout.read_guard states the exact seal). MATRIX document (ADR-0270 rebase, 2026-10-19): the first screen as the 2026-10-18 model record specifies it, on the executable path. Arms: context (22 raw daily returns as the sequence; 16 context scalars: log sessions and calendar days per session as the DTE terms, momentum, realized-vol levels, up/down semivariance, liquidity) and context_chain (the same plus the market quantile function rn_q_* in z units, 19 values, and 9 chain scalars). Encoders: mlp, gru, tcn, dlinear, patchtst_hf32. DEVIATIONS from the record, each needing code and not yet built: sequence in raw returns (not asinh of return over rv_22); the chain branch is the rn_q quantile function, not the 13 logit differences; the queue adds one head per ticker (no shared head). CORRECTION (first launch skipped all 20 cells in 45 s: the external seam requires sequence and context positions to partition the arm's features exactly): arm feature lists are now exactly the 22 lags (oldest first) plus the context scalars (plus the chain columns). WALK-FORWARD document (template, candidate tcn; the other encoders are substituted at run time): arm context_chain only, five folds (warm-up plus four yearly retrains). LONG SCHEDULE (owner 2026-10-20, 'we shouldn't have a low number of epochs that wouldn't determine that it's not learning'): patience 50 and ceiling 150, so every fold trains at least 50 epochs past its best monitor epoch and the full train and monitor curves are recorded; the scored checkpoint is still the best-monitor epoch. ADJUSTMENT R1 (ADR-0270 ladder): single shared head (capacity.pooled.ticker_heads false), weight decay 0.3, dropout 0.2. ROUND 3 (ADR-0270, owner 2026-10-20: Theta's Greeks, IV, quotes, volume and open interest 'should be considered'): M36 wide inputs, the 66 R1 features plus 24 chain inputs the R1 arm omits (own IV, open interest and its change, quote depth, volume, put/call volume imbalance, delta-, gamma- and vega-weighted open interest, volume-weighted spread, liquidity asymmetry, implied minus realized variance, term slopes, 1-day ATM IV change, the 25-delta and put/call-OI flags, the ATM strike node and its neighbours' IV); median-imputed like every input; otherwise identical to R1.
